svg.text: TON-inspired gems, drawn our own way. Each shown big, in the site header, and on night mode.

text.tspan: A cut diamond in blue facets on night:
The gem as a sticker character. Mascot and
diamond in one; great for stickers.
The diamond flipped point-up with a flame: a
Minimal white line diamond on blue: closest
to TON's clean style, without copying it.
Three gems growing along the curve: our
Today's wGRAM coin with a white diamond
